tasks.title: Promptable Multi-View Segmentation
tasks.lead: Prompts given in any subset of views propagate to every view in one forward pass — no per-scene optimization, no tracking, and no pairwise matching between views.

groups.label: AI-generated video
groups.note: Generated indoor walkthroughs (Marble, Atlas, RTFM). These clips have no depth and no poses, so the geometry is VGGT-Omega's own reconstruction — the segmentation head runs on top of it unchanged.

groups.label: ScanNet
groups.note: Real RGB-D scans with sensor depth and poses. 100 views per scene, prompted once with SAM's ten largest disjoint masks on view 0.

groups.label: ScanNet++
groups.note: High-resolution DSLR scans with mesh-rendered depth.

groups.label: Dynamic scene
groups.note: A person moves through the scene while a hand-held camera follows (EMDB clips from MeshMimic). Two text prompts on the first frame — “human” and “floor” — are propagated through every frame of the video. The floor accumulates into the reconstruction. In the bird's-eye view the human's past positions stay behind, one every 10 frames, dimmed, as its 3D track, with the current body in full colour; the follow view shows only the current body.

tasks.title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation
tasks.lead: Open-world detections made on individual frames are carried across views by the same promptable head and fused into 3D instances, each confirmed the moment enough views agree on it.

groups.label: ScanNet
groups.note: Five queries per scene, drawn deterministically from a twenty-word indoor vocabulary, over 120 frames with sensor depth and poses.

groups.label: ScanNet++
groups.note: DSLR scans. The ceiling is clipped away, or the bird's-eye view would look at nothing but the ceiling.

groups.label: FARM-Scenes
groups.note: Large, sparse robot captures — a car museum, a warehouse, a construction site, a robotics building and an outdoor campus ramp, 1,200–15,000 m² each. Indoor furniture words find almost nothing here, so every scene is queried with its own official FARM-Scenes label set (41–97 classes).
